issue.body:
Unfortunately #16282 contained a regression whereby it was assumed that the []*Commits in PushCommits retained its full length and therefore the Len field was dropped. 

This has led to the incorrect reporting of the number of commits in pushes which are larger than `setting.UI.FeedMaxCommitNum`. 

Prior to #16282 the Len was reported on the push commits so mostly we can just drop back to using this, and restart adding it back in.

However, for pushes after this - AFAICS this information is lost and is not recalcuable. Therefore these pushes will be limited to FeedMaxCommitNum.

Fix #16804

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>
